title: 第1章 青铜古镜杂役少年第2章 苟了三年出手就无敌
slug: 我装了三年废物出手人间无敌
content_zh:
青州，太玄宗。
后山，一处悬崖边上。
一名身穿青袍的少年，盘坐在地，目光凝视双膝之间。
只见在他膝盖上，放着一面锈迹斑斑的青铜古镜。
镜子内，一名满头白发的老者，正在挥剑练习，但是不管他怎么修炼，似乎都不满意。
“怎么回事，这套剑法宗主已经修炼了三年，怎么一点进步都没有。”
“哈哈，这就是我常说的废物，这套剑法你一天就学会了，这就是天才和废物的区别。”
就在这时，青铜古镜发出一道嘲讽声。
楚云道：“我也是运气好遇到前辈，不然我也以为自己是个废物。”
楚云本是南阳城楚家嫡长子，因为从小无法修武，所以被当成废物，四处被人欺负。
后来他爹不甘心，将他送到太玄宗修炼，希望奇迹出现。
但是由于楚云没有修为，所以被安排做了杂役弟子。
也就是在做杂役的时候，他在一处山中无意间发现了这面青铜古镜。
古镜里面住着一个镜灵，自称来自仙界。
对方说他不是废物，而是绝世天才，只是丹田被人封印了而已。
开始楚云还不相信，直到对方帮他破解封印，并且传授他一门名为《吞天诀》的绝世功法，让他成为一名武者，他才相信。
在吞天诀的帮助下，楚云只用三年时间，便从灵武境提升地武境。
要知道，青州修炼境界分为灵武境，元武境，玄武境，地武境和天武境五个境界，每个境界又分九重。
楚云能在三年时间，从灵武境提升到地武境，可以说整个青州数千万人口，没有一个人能够做到。
“你也不用谢我，你只要遵守承诺带我回仙界就行。”

“放心，假如真有那一天，我一定带前辈回仙界。”
其实楚云根本不相信有什么仙界，因为他从来没听人说过。
“楚云，原来你在这里，真是害我好找。”
就在这时，一道冰冷的女子声响起。
只见一名身穿红衣，脸色冷漠的女子来到后山。
当看见楚云后，她眼中充满了嫌弃。
楚云快速收起青铜古镜，然后站起身。
“这个贱人又来找你麻烦了，你还要忍到什么时候，要是换成我，早就把她先奸后杀，再奸再杀了。”
镜灵在楚云怀中咒骂道。
他知道这三年，这个红衣女子一直找楚云的麻烦。
红衣女子是太玄宗主的女儿，因为仗着宗主是她爹，所以经常欺负宗门弟子。
不过楚云有点想不通，他跟对方并没有仇，为何对方处处针对他。
“我跟你并没有仇，你为何处处针对我？”
楚云问出心中疑惑。
红女子冷冷一笑，道：“因为有人不想让你好过，最近还出价让我杀你。”
楚云神情冷漠地问道：“谁要杀我？”
他自认三年以来，并没有得罪过任何人。
红衣女子道：“李家的人，他们说要联合王家，将你们楚家斩尽杀绝，算算时间，今天李家和王家应该已经对你们楚家出手了。”
听到此话，楚云双拳猛的握紧，眼中露出杀机。
content_en:
Qingzhou, Taixuanzong.
Back mountain, on the edge of a cliff.
A young man wearing a green robe sat cross-legged on the ground, staring between his knees.
On his knees, there was a rusty ancient bronze mirror.
In the mirror, an old man with white hair was practicing swinging a sword, but no matter how he practiced, he seemed not satisfied.
"What's going on? The sect master has been practicing this set of sword techniques for three years, but there's no progress at all."
"Haha, this is what I often call trash. You can learn this set of swordsmanship in one day. This is the difference between genius and trash."
At this moment, the ancient bronze mirror made a mocking sound.
Chu Yun said: "I was lucky enough to meet a senior, otherwise I would have thought I was a waste."
Chu Yun was originally the eldest son of the Chu family in Nanyang City. Because he was unable to practice martial arts since he was a child, he was treated as a waste and bullied everywhere.
Later, his father was unwilling to give up and sent him to Taixuanzong to practice, hoping for a miracle.
However, because Chu Yun had no cultivation level, he was assigned to be a handyman disciple.
It was while working as a handyman that he accidentally discovered this ancient bronze mirror in a mountain.
Inside the ancient mirror lives a mirror spirit who claims to be from the fairy world.
The other party said that he was not a waste, but a peerless genius, but his Dantian was sealed.
Chu Yun didn't believe it at first, but he didn't believe it until the other party helped him break the seal and taught him a peerless skill called "Swallowing the Sky", allowing him to become a warrior.
With the help of the Heaven-Swallowing Jue, Chu Yun advanced from the Lingwu realm to the Earth martial realm in just three years.
You must know that Qingzhou's cultivation realm is divided into five realms: Lingwu Realm, Yuanwu Realm, Xuanwu Realm, Earth Martial Realm and Tianwu Realm, and each realm is divided into nine levels.
Chu Yun was able to advance from the Lingwu Realm to the Earth Martial Realm in three years. It can be said that no one in the tens of millions of people in Qingzhou could do this.
"You don't have to thank me, you just have to keep your promise and take me back to the fairy world."
"Don't worry, if that day comes, I will definitely take senior back to the fairy world."
In fact, Chu Yun didn't believe in any fairy world at all, because he had never heard of it.
"Chu Yun, it turns out that you are here, making it really difficult for me to find you."
At this moment, a cold female voice sounded.
I saw a woman in red clothes with an indifferent face coming to the back mountain.
When she saw Chu Yun, her eyes were full of disgust.
Chu Yun quickly put away the ancient bronze mirror and stood up.
"This bitch is here to trouble you again. How long do you have to endure it? If it were me, I would have raped her first and then killed her, then raped her again and then killed her."
Jing Ling cursed in Chu Yun's arms.
He knew that the woman in red had been causing trouble for Chu Yun in the past three years.
The woman in red is the daughter of the Taixuan sect leader. Because the sect leader is her father, she often bullies the sect disciples.
But Chu Yun couldn't figure it out. He had no grudge against the other party, so why did the other party target him everywhere.
"I have no grudge against you, why do you target me everywhere?"
Chu Yun asked out his doubts.
The red woman smiled coldly and said, "Because someone doesn't want you to have an easy time, and recently even offered me to kill you."
Chu Yun asked indifferently: "Who wants to kill me?"
He admitted that he had not offended anyone in the past three years.
The woman in red said: "The Li family, they said they would unite with the Wang family and kill all of your Chu family. Counting the time, the Li family and the Wang family should have taken action against your Chu family today."
Upon hearing this, Chu Yun clenched his fists fiercely, with murderous intent in his eyes.
